ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.4.3 (TieJin Modify) 关系概览、低科技适配与三代PNA武器：1.7加载2.4.3新内容，1.6保留2.4.1冻结基线。更新时完整替换旧模组目录，保留版本目录与加载配置。 主从关系卡片支持头像定位、调教员指派及当前地图成员批选；低科技研究与篝火／灶台粗放浓缩连接原有PNA和人格路线。 中世纪、工业与太空共九把PNA武器，配套研究、制作、效力说明、正式美术和紫色反馈。涂覆武器保留真实伤口；太空主攻击对主人保护，对有效锁链目标无伤吸收并即时修复。品质影响伤害和穿甲，不放大药效或修复；分摊伤害不传药。 欢愉恩赐按主人当前身体产液能力决定负荷，其余结算沿用原规则。保留个体凝胶外观、六种特化、主人资格／成长、人格凝胶和身体改造。 升级注意：1.7已移除旧简易PNA发射器、弹丸、配方及专属研究，不提供引用这些定义的存档迁移。1.6原内容保留。 Harmony与RJW先于SSC加载，契约仪式需要Ideology。兔入口仍禁用，旧RimTalk对接暂停。版本及验证见CHANGELOG.md与Docs/Releases/2.4.3/。
Version 2.4.3 — bond overview, low-tech progression and nine PNA weapons. New features target RimWorld 1.7; the 1.6 runtime stays frozen at SSC 2.4.1. Replace the old mod folder completely and keep both version directories and LoadFolders.xml intact. Relationship cards support portrait navigation, trainer assignment and selection of current-map members. Lower-tech research and campfire/stove rough concentration extend access to existing PNA and personality systems. Three weapon eras have dedicated research, crafting, potency displays, art and purple feedback. Coated weapons retain wounds; spacer main attacks protect Masters and allow valid Chain-bound bodies to absorb PNA without wounds and repair an eligible injury. Native quality scales damage and penetration, not potency or repair; shared damage carries no PNA. Bestow Bliss doses now use the Master's current body output. Retains gel appearance, six specializations, Master qualification/progression, personality gel and body modification. The old Basic PNA Launcher and its dedicated definitions are removed from 1.7 without save migration. Frozen 1.6 retains its original content. Load Harmony and RJW before SSC; Binding Rituals require Ideology. Rabbit selection and legacy RimTalk remain unavailable.
